title: Evidence export and video quality
details: Loads the single Evidence Pack.pdf exporter instead of old category-named PDFs
Prevents corrupted em-dash characters in downloaded PDF names
Records guided video at 1080p up to 30fps using the hardware MP4 path when supported
Raises guided video bitrate for smoother, clearer evidence while retaining continuous recording for clean audio
summary: Evia v171 fixes the cached evidence exporter and improves guided video smoothness and quality.
